name: Lisra AI
author: lisraai

sections.description:
Lisra AI puts an AI support agent on your website and connects your store to your Lisra workspace.

  • Chat widget — paste your Lisra widget key and the AI chat agent appears on every page. Visitors chat in any language; a human teammate can take over from Lisra.
  • WooCommerce store sync (optional) — when WooCommerce is active, the plugin can push your product catalog and new orders to Lisra so the agent answers from your real products (prices and stock are never invented) and orders link to your contacts for attribution.

This plugin is a genuine interface to the Lisra AI service (https://app.lisra.ai). The chat widget is a script loaded from Lisra’s servers; store sync sends this site’s own catalog/orders to Lisra’s signed API. No data is sold or shared with third parties.

You need a Lisra account. Get your keys at https://app.lisra.ai.

External services

This plugin connects to Lisra AI (https://app.lisra.ai):

  • The chat widget loads https://app.lisra.ai/api/widget/script on your public pages so visitors can chat.
  • If you enable WooCommerce store sync, product and order data are sent to https://app.lisra.ai/api/store/ingest/*, authenticated with a key and an HMAC signature you configure.

Terms: https://app.lisra.ai/terms — Privacy: https://app.lisra.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings → Lisra AI.
  3. Paste your Widget key (Lisra → Agent → “Install on your website”) and tick Enable widget.
  4. (WooCommerce) Paste your Connection key and Signing secret (Lisra → Website Integrations → “Custom website connector”), tick Enable store sync, Save, then click Sync all products now once.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Lisra account?

Yes. Create one at https://app.lisra.ai and copy your keys from the dashboard.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes — the chat widget works on any WordPress site. Store sync only appears when WooCommerce is installed.
